blurb: Guests can enjoy a selection of craft beers on tap, including IPAs, ales, stouts, and sours, alongside snacks, sharables, hot dogs, and stone-baked pizzas. The brewery has a dog-friendly patio and hosts events such as trivia nights and live music. Private events can be booked by contacting the brewery via email.
